context: Tatsuya and Daichi work together at the farm for harvest.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: だいち、今日、手伝ってくれて、ほんま、助かるわ。
lines.en: Daichi, honestly, I'm really grateful you came to help today.
lines.style: Quiet gratitude with genuine warmth. Open with a soft exhale of relief. Rural vowels loose and easy. Steady, unhurried pace. The warmth is understated but completely sincere—no performance, just honest appreciation.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: こちらこそ。田舎の畑、たまには、ええもんやで。
lines.en: Right back at you. Working the fields out here—it's good for the soul.
lines.style: Kansai lilt bright and natural. Warm agreement that settles into something reflective. The regional swing audible without forcing it. Pace is relaxed, easy. Real contentment threading through—he means this.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: ひかりちゃんも、いつか、ここで、遊んでほしいなあ。
lines.en: I hope Hikari gets to come out here and play sometime.
lines.style: Tender wishing underneath. Rural drawl on the opening, then softens into something vulnerable. Slow, deliberate pacing on the last phrase. The hope is genuine but not insistent—he's placing it gently into the world.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: うん、絶対、連れてくる。田舎、好きになってほしい。
lines.en: Yeah, I'll definitely bring her. I want her to love this place like I do.
lines.style: Kansai warmth with quiet conviction. The commitment lands solid on the first phrase. Then opens into something more tender and philosophical. Regional cadence easy and natural. Real affection underlying every word.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: 家族、ずっと、繋がっていけるって、嬉しい。
lines.en: It makes me happy, you know—family staying connected like this.
lines.style: Rural simplicity carrying something profound. Unhurried delivery with weight behind it. Soft exhale at the opening. The closure trails gently, like he's looking at something distant. Genuine, unguarded tenderness.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ほんま、達也さんが、いてくれて、ありがたい。
lines.en: I'm really grateful you're here, Tatsuya. Truly.
lines.style: Kansai warmth with deep sincerity. Opens with the regional lilt natural and easy. The gratitude is specific and real—not performed, just felt. Pace slows slightly on the closing. The warmth is bone-deep.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: こちらこそ。一緒に、頑張ろな。
lines.en: Same goes for me. Let's keep doing our best together.
lines.style: Rural ease and quiet steadiness. Simple words carrying real meaning. Measured, calm delivery. The reciprocal warmth is understated but complete. Closes with gentle resolution—not emphatic, just certain.
